title: Surface environment incompatibility as linkage failure
narrative: Missing environment capability must become a structured pre-exec failure, not a mysterious mid-run error. Accepts inspiration requirement 16[^insp-r16].
implementation: `InferenceEnvironment.assert_compatible` is consulted by `DefaultLinkageResolver`; mismatches become `environment_incompatible` edges.
validation: Kind `environment_linkage_fail`. Soft expects environment_incompatible code when grants are required but absent.
